preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == n - 1 and all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines() for u, v in [line.split()]))
postconditions.description: The output must either be '-1' or contain n-1 edges connecting valid nodes.

postconditions.expression: any(int(u) == 1 or int(v) == 1 for line in stdout.splitlines() for u, v in [line.split()])
postconditions.description: At least one edge must connect to node 1, ensuring the tree is rooted at node 1.

postconditions.expression: len(set(line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines())) == n - 1
postconditions.description: All edges must be unique, ensuring no duplicate edges in the output.
